newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested.
Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. There were 26,600 head confirmed for the week to date which represents formulated cattle cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was $66.00 per cwt on last Thursday. Tuesday's packer bids were $65.00, with asking prices $66.00-$68.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
